notes:
StreamMate now comes in two builds. The Google Play build is installed and updated by Google Play, so it has no Updates page. The Dev build gets test builds straight away through Settings > Updates, and installs next to the Play copy with its own data. About shows "Dev build" next to the build number. To move your setup over, back it up in Settings > Backup and restore it in the other app.
Recordings and reminders: onboarding's Reminders page now also asks for Android's Alarms & reminders access, so they start right on time. If it's off, Settings > Recordings has an Allow alarms button.
